object.name: session_power_manager
object.description: Interface for querying and requesting system power operations. A client may use the per-operation capability events to present the operations that are currently available. These events are advisory: the server validates every request again when it is received. The result of each operation is reported on this object with done or error.

s2c.name: can_reboot
s2c.description: Non-zero if reboot is configured, this client may request it without first closing other users' sessions, and no shutdown inhibitor blocks the request. Sent when the object is created and whenever availability changes.

arg.name: can_reboot
arg.summary: non-zero if reboot is currently allowed
